thesis: When an MR40 first-positive episode closes in the bottom fifth of its own four-hour high-low range on a red candle with >=1.5x prior-20-bar mean volume, contemporaneous sell pressure may persist into the next open; vetoing the whole episode may reduce adverse drawdown without destroying profitable mean reversion entries.
uniqueness: Distinct from previously rejected green_reversal, drift6, range_quiet14, trend60, reversal_and_quiet; uses joint close-location and relative contemporaneous volume, both observable at closed signal bar.
signal_timing: Only at first CLOSED positive signal bar j, based on OHLCV at or before j. Veto entire contiguous entry episode; do not reenter later during it. Next-bar-open entry and natural Z>=0 exit preserved; no change to sizing/stops, no intrabar oracle fills.

economic_gate.train: candidate normal and stress net PNL >= matching baseline; candidate LOW DD <=90% of baseline in both; retain >=80% baseline winners and >=90% of baseline historical winner profit; >=1 baseline losing episode vetoed
economic_gate.evaluation_seen: same frozen thresholds plus candidate stress and normal net PNL >= baseline; no automated selection on evaluation
economic_gate.decision: FAIL if any gate fails; even success is exploratory only due to prior historical exposure; never change Paper or claim independent prospective OOS

outputs: baseline parity on each 4h historical candle path against frozen reference
candidate full cash/equity simulation after first-signal-only veto
vetoed losing and winning episodes and historical winning PNL sacrificed, with caveat gross historical attribution != candidate compounded account PNL
train/evaluation normal/stress 500 USDT net PNL; Close and Low DD, fees, fills, position count
integrity: Validate full OHLC digest, pinned ledger SHA, chronological 4h bar sequence, signal episode ID and baseline replay, reject partial reports and overwrite.
future_gate: For independent proof require genuinely new post-preregistration Bybit Spot fully CLOSED episodes with authenticated 4h data; no historical data (2023-2026) counted as unseen; at least 12 fully closed positions in both arms before economic promotion may even be discussed; no auto promotion.
